```{r}
library(partykit)
# parameters of event_time
dist = "log-normal"
time_point = 5
params = list()
if(dist=="exponential"){
  params$lambda_base = 2
}else if(dist == "Weibull"){
  params$lambda_base = 5
  params$alpha = 2
} else if(dist == "log-logistic"){
  params$lambda_base = 4
  params$alpha = 1.2
} else if (dist == "log-normal"){
  params$mean = 2
  params$sd = 0.8
} else{
  stop("Unsupported distribution")
}

# parameters of censor_time
censor_params = list()
censor_dist = "uniform"
if(censor_dist=="exponential"){
  censor_params$lambda = 0.2
}else if(censor_dist == "Weibull"){
  censor_params$lambda = 0.5
  censor_params$alpha = 2
} else if(censor_dist == "log-logistic"){
  censor_params$lambda = 4
  censor_params$alpha = 1.2
} else if (censor_dist == "log-normal"){
  censor_params$mean = 2
  censor_params$sd = 0.7
} else if (censor_dist == "uniform"){
  censor_params$start = 1
  censor_params$end = 8
} else{
  stop("Unsupported distribution")
}
```

```{r}
evaluate_tree_survival_models <- function(dt, index, beta, seed, num_obs, num_covariates, dist, params, censor_dist, censor_params, time_point, train_prop = 0.7){
  naive_performance <- vector("list", seed)
  ipcw_performance <- vector("list", seed)
  survtree_performance <- vector("list", seed)

  for (i in 1:seed) {
    # Generate covariates and continuous response
    X <- matrix(rnorm(num_obs * num_covariates), nrow = num_obs, ncol = num_covariates)
    colnames(X) <- paste0("X", 1:num_covariates)
    Y_continuous <- generate_Y_continuous(X, index, beta)

    # Prepare data for the tree
    data_tree <- as.data.frame(X)
    data_tree$Y_continuous <- Y_continuous

    # Fit a regression tree and predict f(X)
    tree_model_fX <- rpart(Y_continuous ~ ., data = data_tree)
    f_X <- predict(tree_model_fX, data_tree)
    params$lc <- f_X
    power <- exp(params$lc)

    # Simulate survival data
    dt = simulation_data(num_obs, dist, params, censor_dist, censor_params, time_point, X)
    dt$power <- power

    # Split into training and testing data
    train_index <- sample(seq_len(nrow(dt)), size = floor(train_prop * nrow(dt)))
    train_data <- dt[train_index, ]
    test_data <- dt[-train_index, ]
    test_IPCW <- get_IPCW_relevant(test_data, time_point, return_type = "IPCW")

    # Create a survival tree formula and fit the model
    var_name <- colnames(X)
    formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(observed_time, sigma) ~", paste(var_name, collapse = " + ")))
    surv_tree <- rpart(formula, data = train_data)

    # Predict hazards from the survival tree
    hazards <- predict(surv_tree, newdata = test_data, type = "matrix")[, 1]

    # Fit a parametric survival model and calculate probabilities
    s0 <- survreg(Surv(observed_time, sigma) ~ 1, data = train_data, dist = "exponential")
    e0 <- exp(-summary(s0)$coefficients[1])
    surv_tree_surv_prob <- exp(-e0 * hazards * time_point)
    surv_tree_event_prob <- 1 - surv_tree_surv_prob

    # Compute true survival and model predictions
    true_surv <- (true_survival_function(dist, time_point, params = params))^(test_data$power)
    naive_survProb <- naive_estimate(train_data, test_data, var_name, "tree")
    ipcw_survProb <- ipcw_estimate(train_data, test_data, time_point, var_name, "tree")

    # Calculate OLS errors
    ols_naive <- ols_error(true_surv, naive_survProb)
    ols_ipcw <- ols_error(true_surv, ipcw_survProb)
    ols_survtree <- ols_error(true_surv, surv_tree_surv_prob)

    # Calculate C-index
    c_index_naive <- c_index_censoring(test_data$observed_time, test_data$sigma, 1 - naive_survProb)
    c_index_ipcw <- c_index_censoring(test_data$observed_time, test_data$sigma, 1 - ipcw_survProb)
    c_index_st <- c_index_censoring(test_data$observed_time, test_data$sigma, surv_tree_event_prob)

    # Calculate Weighted Brier Scores
    Bscore_naive <- Weighted_Brier_Score(1 - naive_survProb, test_data$E, test_IPCW)
    Bscore_ipcw <- Weighted_Brier_Score(1 - ipcw_survProb, test_data$E, test_IPCW)
    Bscore_st <- Weighted_Brier_Score(surv_tree_event_prob, test_data$E, test_IPCW)

    # Store performance metrics
    naive_performance[[i]] <- c(ols_naive, c_index_naive, Bscore_naive)
    ipcw_performance[[i]] <- c(ols_ipcw, c_index_ipcw, Bscore_ipcw)
    survtree_performance[[i]] <- c(ols_survtree, c_index_st, Bscore_st)
  }

  # Convert lists to matrices for easier summarization
  naive_matrix <- do.call(rbind, naive_performance)
  ipcw_matrix <- do.call(rbind, ipcw_performance)
  survtree_matrix <- do.call(rbind, survtree_performance)

  # Calculate mean performance metrics for each method
  results <- data.frame(
    Method = c("Naive", "IPCW", "Survival Tree"),
    Mean_OLS_Error = c(mean(naive_matrix[, 1]), mean(ipcw_matrix[, 1]), mean(survtree_matrix[, 1])),
    Mean_C_Index = c(mean(naive_matrix[, 2]), mean(ipcw_matrix[, 2]), mean(survtree_matrix[, 2])),
    Mean_Brier_Score = c(mean(naive_matrix[, 3]), mean(ipcw_matrix[, 3]), mean(survtree_matrix[, 3]))
  )

  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
num_obs = 500
seed = 20
time_point = 5
num_covariates = 10
ind = c(1,2,3, 7)
beta = c(1,-2,0.5, 0.2)
evaluate_tree_survival_models(dt, ind, beta, seed, num_obs, num_covariates, dist, params, censor_dist, censor_params, time_point)
```
